what: Inside a 1px-border oval pill (140×62), a strip made of eight repeats of the button label and a small icon flows endlessly left by one button width over 10s (5.5s under 767px). On hover it flips in .3s ease to an ink panel with white text, and the open/close button (aria-expanded=true) stands as a slightly darker ink-colored plate — text lines still flow. Menu·Contact buttons at the header corner

options.repeat: How many sets to join end to end, default 8
options.dur: One flow cycle (seconds), default 10 — on phones --fx-dur-narrow (default 5.5s)
options.--fx-w · --fx-h · --fx-size: Pill size and text size (via style), default 140px · 62px · 20px
options.[data-fx-part=row]: One set of flowing text (required) — text and icon svg
options.--fx-ink: Border · text color (via style), default --kf-ink — the original is a step lighter ink (--kf-ink-soft)

from.where: shared header Menu·Contact pill buttons (--fx-ink: --kf-ink-soft) (c-button-scroll · button-marquee 10s/5.5s)
